oneOf.title: Two-person natal synastry report request

domains.description: Absent selects all six builtin pair profiles. Empty requires nonempty customProfiles.

timeZone.description: IANA ID in the pinned bundled tzdb; no host timezone inference.

oneOf.$comment: Birth inputs are Gregorian UTC with exact integer-valued calendar components. The same profile selectors are applied independently to both people. Calendar validity, unique custom/section IDs, and unique aspect angles are enforced by core. IDs from all individual and pair builtin profiles are reserved. All $refs resolve through local schema IDs; no network resolution is required.
